transaction.scope: Same-version GTK4 schema/legal-only update; all libraries/configurations/preferences unchanged. Actual GNOME desktop portal schema plus all installed stock schema inputs, no graphical acceptance.
transaction.recovery: Inspect package/receipt/postconditions before action. Retained GTK toddy13 archive/record restores previous owned cache and metadata; installed source XML remains intact. Verify old payload. No rollback executed and no uncertain replay.

installed_consumer.scope: Owned GTK same-version shared schema cache: actual installed default-source lookup and all current key/type/default/range contracts; no user values changed. Native portal appearance/consent/cancel/denial remain pending.
